head: cloud/websocket-listen-timeout
title: fix(serve): keep listening WebSocket clients connected past the idle timeout
body:
`handle_connection` sets a 120 s `SO_RCVTIMEO` on every client socket, and the upgraded `WebSocket` keeps it as its idle limit. `WebSocket::Read` treated the resulting `EAGAIN` like a closed peer. `ReadLoop` then marked the session closed, which cancels the TTS/ASR work through `cancelled()`, and no Close frame was sent.

Example: a `/v1/audio/speech/stream` client sends its text and `input.done`, then only listens. If synthesis and streaming take more than 120 s after its last message, the server cancels the utterance mid-stream. The client sees an abnormal drop.

Change:
- `WebSocket` reads the inherited receive timeout once and records the time of each successful `send`.
- When a receive times out but the server sent something within that window, the reader keeps waiting.
- When neither side has sent anything for the full window, the session closes with a 1001 Close frame instead of dropping silently.

The 120 s value and the HTTP path are unchanged.

Test: `audio_websocket_test` adds `ListeningClientIsNotIdle`. It drives a `WebSocket` over a socketpair with a 300 ms receive timeout and streams frames for 1.2 s while the client stays silent. It asserts the session is not cancelled, then that a silent session receives Close 1001. On unpatched main the test fails at the first `SendBinary` after the timeout.

Built in a cloud session (CPU only); Strix Halo validation pending.

> AI disclosure: I am not a software developer. Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) developed and tested this patch; this is not a claim of human developer review. Claude Code cloud session, CPU only, no GPU testing.

Test scope (Linux x86-64 cloud VM, no GPU, Ubuntu GCC/CMake rather than the Nix toolchain):
- `cmake --preset cpu-test && cmake --build --preset pr --parallel 4`: 54/54 hosted tests passed.
- The new test fails on main without the fix and passes with it. `audio_websocket_test` passed 15 consecutive runs (RelWithDebInfo) and 3 runs under `cpu-sanitizer` (ASan+UBSan, Debug) with no sanitizer reports.
- `tools/ci/check-format.py` with the Nix-pinned clang-tools: PASS. `tools/ci/check-pr-title.py`: PASS.
- Not run: a live 120 s TTS stream against a real model, any GPU or functional test.
